summary: Tested RSVP backend (POST/GET), RSVP form (accept + decline), /rsvp-admin page, Add-to-Calendar menu + Google links + .ics, Page 1 chip transition, chime mute toggle, and mobile viewport. Backend 5/5 pytest passed; frontend end-to-end flows all green with no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: RsvpAdmin at secret URL /rsvp-admin has NO authentication. Security-through-obscurity only — acceptable per user choice but worth noting.
RSVP form has no client-side rate limiting or duplicate submission protection; a user could spam-create records.
Backend POST /api/rsvp accepts empty-after-strip name (returns 200 with name=''). Consider validating min length server-side.
App.js: useEffect dependency array misses isAdmin (linter should flag). Not causing bugs but technically incorrect.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ prefixed RSVPs (TEST_Alice, TEST_Bob, TEST_Clamp, TEST_ClampMax, TEST_UIUser, TEST_UIDecline) in rsvps collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_rsvp.py run via pytest. Public URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All features from iteration 4 (RSVP backend+form, admin page, Add-to-Calendar, PCB-signal chip transition, chime mute toggle) verified working. Backend seed data has TEST_ prefixed rows that can be ignored or cleaned later.
